\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{datavisualization.formats.functions}
\begin{document}
\tikz \datavisualization [scientific axes=clean,
  x axis={length=8cm,min value=-100,max value=100,ticks={step=50},grid},
  y axis={length=2cm,min value=0,max value=100,ticks={step=50},grid},
  visualize as scatter,
  legend={east outside},
  scatter={style={mark=*,mark size=2pt,blue},label in legend={text={measurements at $x_i$}}}]
data point [x=-100,y=25]
data point [x=0,y=75]
data point [x=100,y=50];
\end{document}
